description: This file defines serialization and copying logic for unknown types within the Orleans framework, specifically implementing a VoidCodec and VoidCopier classes for handling null or unknown references.

classes.name: VoidCodec
classes.description: Serializer for unknown types, handling writing and reading of reference fields.

classes.name: VoidCopier
classes.description: Copier for unknown types, providing deep copy functionality that expects null values.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field, throwing if the value is not null.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value, expecting a reference type.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of the input, expecting null values.
